query: UPDATE issues SET archived_at=now(),updated_at=now(),version=version+1 WHERE id IN (SELECT i.id FROM issues i JOIN stages s ON s.id=i.stage_id AND s.kind='done' JOIN teams t ON t.id=i.team_id WHERE i.archived_at IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.archive_after_days IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(i.done_at,i.updated_at) <= now()-make_interval(days=>t.archive_after_days) ORDER BY i.done_at NULLS LAST,i.id LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
